card.name: Determiner after a transitive verb
card.fires_on: The word 'the', 'your', 'their', or 'us' right after a verb such as show, utter, develop, deepen, keep, or defend, where a direct object comes next. It appears in general narrative and web prose.

modes.label: Article after verb
modes.description: 'the' directly after an action verb, before an abstract or concrete object.

modes.label: Possessive or pronoun object
modes.description: 'your', 'their', or 'us' right after a verb, starting the object phrase.
modes.example: He defended<< their>> decision by publicly announcing in a journal:

card.writes: It leans toward unusual or abstract continuations and away from the word 'own' and its foreign-language forms.
card.plain: It fires on the little word that comes right after a verb and begins the thing being acted on, such as 'the' in 'keep the money'.
